summary: LDAP servers with self-signed or internal-CA certificates need the CA in the system trust store, and that certificate is not migrated to platform gateway on upgrade; from 2.4, authenticator configs and is_superuser/is_system_auditor group flags migrate, but is_active does not (use a deny rule).
questions: LDAP certificate issuer not recognized in AAP
Is my LDAP CA certificate migrated when upgrading to 2.6?
